result.reason: The redline appropriately removes Licensor’s automatic termination/consent right for Licensee’s change of control and adds notice, but it does not establish either playbook assignment position. It omits Licensee’s affiliate-assignment right, successor-assignment mechanics, restrictions on Licensor assignments, and the prohibition on assignment to a Licensee competitor. It also leaves Licensor’s right of first refusal over a sale or merger intact, despite the comment objecting to an effective veto. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions. The edits are narrowly scoped and generally clear, but substantively incomplete.
